import random
def comb(co, a, b, c):
    return tuple(co[0]*a[i] + co[1]*b[i] + co[2]*c[i] for i in range(3))
def cross(x, y):
    return (x[1]*y[2]-x[2]*y[1], x[2]*y[0]-x[0]*y[2], x[0]*y[1]-x[1]*y[0])
def collinear(P, Q, R):
    d1 = tuple(Q[i]-P[i] for i in range(3))
    d2 = tuple(R[i]-P[i] for i in range(3))
    return cross(d1, d2) == (0, 0, 0)
